result.verdict: W1 PASS + W2 KILL (scope-(a)). The first-principles categorical Q_beta net -- the augmentation Delta(net) of the H_3 GS-reduced nucleon NF -- reproduces the counit through O(hbar^2) (W1), but the FULL GS net is NOT the production cos*(1 + c_k u^2) ladder: Q_beta^GS/Q_A = 1 + hbar^2 - 2 hbar^3 - ... is cosh-like (leading +hbar^2), and Q_beta^GS/Q_N1 - 1 carries a leading O(hbar^2)=O(u) term (coeff 9/8) BELOW the c_2 u^2 (O(hbar^4)) rung, so it is not of pure ladder shape. Numerically the full GS net gives Q_beta = +0.75% vs CODATA, WORSE than the N=0 truncation Q_A (+0.17%): the categorical higher orders push away from the ladder. scope-(a): this refutes the hypothesis 'full GS augmentation == production ladder', NOT the ladder ansatz or any c_k. W3 (c_2 reproduction) is moot under this kill. NO c_k value; nothing wired.
